grammar_title: 主语从句 & 表语从句(subject clauses & predicative clauses)
source: 上外版选择性必修二 Unit 2 Grammar in Use:主语从句与表语从句的连接词选择(that/whether/what/how/why 等)。句子地道、答案唯一(从句是否缺成分 + 句意决定连接词)。

points.point: 主语从句(句首):连接词选择
points.overview: 名词性从句放句首作主语时:从句完整且陈述事实用 that;表'是否'的疑问用 whether(不用 if);从句缺主语或宾语(=所…的事物)用 what;问方式/程度用 how;问原因用 why。

points.point: it 作形式主语:真正主语后置
points.overview: 用 it 作形式主语、真正的主语从句后置:It is + 形容词/名词/过去分词 + that(陈述)/whether(是否)/what·how·why(疑问词)从句。如 It is true that… / It is unknown whether… / It is amazing how…。

points.point: 表语从句(系动词 be 之后)
points.overview: 名词性从句跟在系动词 be 后作表语;连接词由主语名词与从句意义决定:fact/truth/idea/belief/point + that;question/problem + whether;The reason is that…;That is why…;主语为 this/that/all、从句缺成分 + what。

questions.stem: "____ our language really shapes our thoughts has interested scientists for years."
questions.explanation: 句首主语从句表'是否'的待解疑问 → whether(不用 if);从句完整,what 多余。

questions.stem: "____ surprised the researchers most was the speed of the answers."
questions.explanation: 从句缺主语(____ surprised…)→ what(=the thing that)。

questions.stem: "____ language can shape thought is now widely accepted by experts."
questions.explanation: 从句完整、陈述被接受的事实 → that。

questions.stem: "____ languages describe colours differs from culture to culture."
questions.explanation: 'differs from culture to culture'指方式不同 → how。

questions.stem: "____ babies can tell two languages apart was tested in the study."
questions.explanation: 研究检验的是'能否'这一疑问 → whether。

questions.stem: "____ each language asks us to notice can differ a great deal."
questions.explanation: 从句缺宾语(asks us to notice ____)→ what。

questions.stem: "____ every healthy child can learn a language is simply a fact."
questions.explanation: 从句完整、点明它'是一个事实'→ that。

questions.stem: "____ quickly we name a colour varies from language to language."
questions.explanation: 'how quickly'表程度 → how。

questions.stem: "____ she discovered about colour words changed the debate."
questions.explanation: 从句缺宾语(discovered ____)→ what。

questions.stem: "____ speaking two languages slows the brain was the real question."
questions.explanation: 'was the real question'指'是否'的疑问 → whether(不用 if)。

questions.stem: "____ no two languages divide the world alike is well known."
questions.explanation: 从句完整、是众所周知的事实 → that。

questions.stem: "____ we call 'blue' may not exist in another language."
questions.explanation: 从句缺宾语(we call ____ 'blue')→ what。

questions.stem: "____ a dying language can be saved depends on its young speakers."
questions.explanation: 'depends on'后接'能否'的疑问 → whether。

questions.stem: "____ words can shape our feelings is no surprise to linguists."
questions.explanation: 从句完整、是'不足为奇'的事实 → that。

questions.stem: "____ the speaker described was a simple colour experiment."
questions.explanation: 从句缺宾语(described ____)→ what。

questions.stem: "____ varies from person to person is the way they picture time."
questions.explanation: 从句缺主语(____ varies…)→ what。

questions.stem: "____ colour words affect memory was the focus of the test."
questions.explanation: 测试的焦点是'是否'这一疑问 → whether。

questions.stem: "____ matters is not where others live but how you think."
questions.explanation: 从句缺主语(____ matters)→ what。

questions.stem: "____ the human mind is so flexible is clear from its love of language."
questions.explanation: 从句完整、是'显而易见'的事实 → that。

questions.stem: "____ some small languages disappear so fast is still a mystery."
questions.explanation: 'is still a mystery'指未解的原因 → why。

questions.stem: "It is true ____ language can change the way we see colour."
questions.explanation: It is true 后接陈述事实的主语从句 → that。

questions.stem: "It remains unknown ____ a dying language can ever be revived."
questions.explanation: remains unknown 后是'能否'的疑问 → whether。

questions.stem: "It is amazing ____ quickly Russian speakers spot light blue."
questions.explanation: 'how quickly'表程度 → how。

questions.stem: "It is no surprise ____ bilingual brains often stay sharper."
questions.explanation: It is no surprise 后接陈述事实 → that。

questions.stem: "It is doubtful ____ language alone can determine our thoughts."
questions.explanation: doubtful 表怀疑'是否' → whether。

questions.stem: "It is hard to say ____ makes one language die before another."
questions.explanation: 从句缺主语(____ makes…)→ what。

questions.stem: "It is well known ____ no two languages divide the world alike."
questions.explanation: well known 后接公认的事实 → that。

questions.stem: "It is still unclear ____ babies can tell two languages apart."
questions.explanation: unclear 表不确定'能否' → whether。

questions.stem: "It is interesting ____ differently languages treat the same event."
questions.explanation: 'how differently'表程度/方式 → how。

questions.stem: "It is widely accepted ____ thought and language influence each other."
questions.explanation: widely accepted 后接被接受的事实 → that。

questions.stem: "It is not always obvious ____ a language asks us to pay attention to."
questions.explanation: 从句缺宾语(pay attention to ____)→ what。

questions.stem: "It is a real mystery ____ so many languages are vanishing at once."
questions.explanation: a mystery 指未解的原因 → why。

questions.stem: "It is surprising ____ a single kind sentence can lift a whole day."
questions.explanation: surprising 后陈述令人惊讶的事实 → that。

questions.stem: "It matters little ____ you call it 'goluboy' or 'siniy'."
questions.explanation: 'whether…or…'表'不论是否' → whether。

questions.stem: "It is fascinating ____ the mind handles two languages at the same time."
questions.explanation: 指大脑处理的'方式' → how。

questions.stem: "It is often forgotten ____ some thoughts need no language at all."
questions.explanation: forgotten 后接被遗忘的事实 → that。

questions.stem: "It is worth asking ____ we think the way that we do."
questions.explanation: asking 后问'为什么这样想' → why。

questions.stem: "It is clear ____ our first language leaves a deep mark on us."
questions.explanation: It is clear 后接清楚的事实 → that。

questions.stem: "It is uncertain ____ saving a script can save a spoken language."
questions.explanation: uncertain 表不确定'能否' → whether。

questions.stem: "It is no wonder ____ learning a language reshapes the brain."
questions.explanation: no wonder 后陈述'难怪'的事实 → that。

questions.stem: "The truth is ____ language and thought shape each other."
questions.explanation: 主语 truth、从句陈述事实 → 表语从句用 that。

questions.stem: "The real question is ____ language shapes thought or the other way round."
questions.explanation: 主语 question、表'是否/哪一种' → whether。

questions.stem: "What still puzzles me is ____ a baby learns to speak so quickly."
questions.explanation: 表语从句指学说话的'方式' → how。

questions.stem: "One common belief is ____ any language can be mastered with practice."
questions.explanation: 主语 belief、从句陈述内容 → that。

questions.stem: "The reason is ____ their language makes them notice such details."
questions.explanation: 'The reason is + 表语从句'用 that(不用 why)。

questions.stem: "The problem is ____ we can ever fully translate one language into another."
questions.explanation: 主语 problem、表'能否'的疑问 → whether。

questions.stem: "His greatest fear is ____ his mother tongue will die out."
questions.explanation: 表语从句陈述所担心的内容 → that。

questions.stem: "That is ____ Russian speakers react to shades of blue so fast."
questions.explanation: 'That is why…'说明原因 → why。

questions.stem: "The first thing she noticed was ____ the two words sounded almost alike."
questions.explanation: 表语从句陈述她注意到的事实 → that。

questions.stem: "This is ____ language can quietly do to our thinking."
questions.explanation: 从句缺宾语(do ____ to our thinking)→ what。

questions.stem: "The point is ____ small words can steer big decisions."
questions.explanation: 主语 point、从句陈述要点 → that。

questions.stem: "What matters most is ____ you pay attention to, not where you live."
questions.explanation: 从句缺宾语(pay attention to ____)→ what。

questions.stem: "The mystery is ____ so many languages are disappearing today."
questions.explanation: 主语 mystery、追问原因 → why。

questions.stem: "Her firm belief is ____ every language opens a new window on the world."
questions.explanation: 主语 belief、从句陈述信念 → that。

questions.stem: "The strange thing is ____ we rarely ask why we think as we do."
questions.explanation: 从句完整、陈述'奇怪的事实' → that。

questions.stem: "The whole point of her talk was ____ language shapes us all."
questions.explanation: 从句陈述演讲要点 → that。

questions.stem: "The open question is ____ thought can exist without any words."
questions.explanation: 主语 question、表'能否'的疑问 → whether。

questions.stem: "The best part is ____ learning a language actually reshapes the brain."
questions.explanation: 从句陈述'最棒的部分'这一事实 → that。

questions.stem: "His only doubt is ____ a written record can keep a language alive."
questions.explanation: 主语 doubt、表'能否'的疑问 → whether。

questions.stem: "The amazing fact is ____ no single language can capture every idea."
questions.explanation: 主语 fact、从句陈述事实 → that。
